title: WEDNESDAY POSTERIOR
subtitle: WEDNESDAY. POSTERIOR CHAIN. GLUTES, HAMSTRINGS, BACK. BRIDGES, LUNGES, BIRD DOGS, ONE-LEG HINGE FOR BALANCE. THEN OPEN THE HAMSTRINGS AND HIPS. FEEL IT. DO NOT BE SORE TOMORROW.

script.welcome: ON YOUR FEET. WEDNESDAY. POSTERIOR CHAIN. SEVENTEEN MINUTES. THE BACK HALF OF YOU. GLUTES, HAMSTRINGS, SPINE. BRIDGES, LUNGES, BIRD DOGS, A ONE LEG HINGE. THEN WE OPEN THE HAMSTRINGS AND HIPS. THAT CHAIR HAS BEEN SITTING ON YOUR BACKSIDE ALL WEEK. TODAY YOUR BACKSIDE FIGHTS BACK.
script.start: CLOCK IS LIVE. MOVE YOUR ARSE. LITERALLY. THAT IS TODAY'S TARGET.
script.rest: REST. BREATHE. HANDS OFF THAT BLOODY PHONE.
script.lastSet: LAST ROUND. FINISH CLEAN. I'M WATCHING.
script.complete: DISMISSED. GLUTES AWAKE. HAMSTRINGS LONG. HIPS OPEN. BALANCE OWNED. GO AND SIT DOWN LIKE A MAN WHO KNOWS HE HAS A BACKSIDE, NOT A SACK OF WET LAUNDRY DUMPED IN A CHAIR.
script.pause: HOLD. CLOCK STOPPED. DO NOT GET COMFY.

exercises.name: GLUTE BRIDGE
exercises.cue: ON YOUR BACK, KNEES BENT, FEET FLAT AND HIP-WIDTH, HEELS A HAND'S LENGTH FROM YOUR BACKSIDE. SQUEEZE THE GLUTES AND DRIVE THROUGH THE HEELS UNTIL SHOULDERS, HIPS AND KNEES MAKE A LINE. PAUSE ONE SECOND AT THE TOP. LOWER SLOW. RIBS DOWN, NO ARCHING THE LOW BACK.
exercises.speakStart: GLUTE BRIDGES. THREE SETS. TEN REPS. FEET FLAT. DRIVE THROUGH THE HEELS. SQUEEZE AT THE TOP AND HOLD ONE SECOND. LOWER SLOW. THOSE GLUTES HAVE BEEN ASLEEP SINCE THE BLOODY MILLENNIUM. WAKE THEM UP.
exercises.speakRest: THIRTY. STAY ON THE DECK. BREATHE.
exercises.speakDone: BRIDGES DONE. BACKSIDE REPORTING FOR DUTY.

exercises.name: CHAIR-ASSISTED REVERSE LUNGE
exercises.cue: STAND BESIDE A STURDY CHAIR, ONE HAND ON THE BACK FOR BALANCE. STEP ONE FOOT BACK AND LOWER UNTIL THE BACK KNEE HOVERS A FEW INCHES OFF THE FLOOR. FRONT KNEE OVER THE ANKLE, CHEST TALL, SLIGHT FORWARD LEAN. DRIVE UP THROUGH THE FRONT HEEL. SHORTER RANGE IS FINE IF THE KNEE GRUMBLES.
exercises.speakStart: REVERSE LUNGES. HAND ON THE CHAIR. TWO SETS. SIX EACH LEG. STEP BACK. LOWER SLOW. DRIVE UP THROUGH THE FRONT HEEL. CHEST TALL. NO COLLAPSING LIKE A DECKCHAIR IN A GALE.
exercises.speakRest: FORTY. SHAKE THE LEGS OUT. EYES ON YOU.

exercises.name: BIRD DOG
exercises.cue: ON HANDS AND KNEES, HANDS UNDER SHOULDERS, KNEES UNDER HIPS. BRACE THE BELLY. SLOWLY REACH ONE ARM FORWARD AND THE OPPOSITE LEG BACK UNTIL BOTH ARE LEVEL WITH YOUR BACK. HOLD TWO SECONDS. RETURN AND SWITCH. BACK FLAT AS A TABLE. HIPS DO NOT TWIST.
exercises.speakStart: BIRD DOGS. TWO SETS. FIVE EACH SIDE. HANDS AND KNEES. OPPOSITE ARM AND LEG. REACH LONG. HOLD TWO SECONDS. BACK FLAT AS A TABLE. IF I COULD NOT REST A CUP OF TEA ON YOUR BACK, YOU ARE DOING IT WRONG.
exercises.speakDone: BIRD DOGS DONE. SPINE STEADY. GOOD.

exercises.name: CHAIR-ASSISTED SINGLE-LEG HINGE
exercises.cue: STAND ON ONE LEG BESIDE A CHAIR, FINGERTIPS ON THE CHAIR BACK, SOFT KNEE. HINGE FORWARD AT THE HIPS, FLAT BACK, AS THE FREE LEG FLOATS STRAIGHT BEHIND YOU. GO ONLY AS FAR AS YOU CAN KEEP THE HIPS SQUARE, THEN SQUEEZE THE GLUTE TO STAND TALL. SLOW. THIS IS YOUR BALANCE WORK.
exercises.speakStart: SINGLE LEG HINGES. FINGERTIPS ON THE CHAIR. TWO SETS. FIVE EACH LEG. TIP FORWARD FROM THE HIPS. BACK LEG FLOATS BEHIND YOU. FLAT BACK. SQUEEZE THE BACKSIDE TO STAND UP. THIS IS YOUR BALANCE WORK. YOU ARE A GRACEFUL BLOODY FLAMINGO TODAY. A LARGE ONE. BUT GRACEFUL.
exercises.speakDone: BALANCE DONE. STEADY ON YOUR PINS. GOOD.

exercises.name: STAIR HAMSTRING STRETCH
exercises.cue: FACE THE STAIRS. REST ONE HEEL ON THE FIRST OR SECOND STEP, TOES UP, KNEE SOFT. HANDS ON THE THIGHS. HINGE FORWARD FROM THE HIPS WITH A LONG FLAT BACK UNTIL YOU FEEL THE BACK OF THE THIGH. DO NOT ROUND THE SPINE TO CHASE THE TOES. BREATHE AND SETTLE.
exercises.speakStart: HAMSTRING STRETCH ON THE STAIRS. TWO ROUNDS. THIRTY SECONDS EACH LEG. HEEL ON THE FIRST STEP. LONG FLAT BACK. TIP FORWARD FROM THE HIPS. NO BOUNCING. YOU ARE NOT A BLOODY POGO STICK.
exercises.speakDone: HAMSTRINGS DONE. THEY SHOULD THANK ME. THEY WILL NOT.

exercises.name: SEATED FIGURE-FOUR HIP OPENER
exercises.cue: SIT TALL NEAR THE FRONT OF A STURDY CHAIR. CROSS ONE ANKLE OVER THE OPPOSITE KNEE, LETTING THE TOP KNEE DROP OUT TO THE SIDE. FLEX THE TOP FOOT. KEEP A LONG SPINE AND LEAN THE CHEST FORWARD UNTIL YOU FEEL THE OUTER HIP AND GLUTE OPEN. BREATHE INTO IT. NO FORCING THE KNEE DOWN.
exercises.speakStart: FIGURE FOUR HIP OPENER. ON THE CHAIR. TWO ROUNDS. THIRTY SECONDS EACH SIDE. ANKLE OVER THE KNEE. SIT TALL. LEAN FORWARD SLOW. THIS IS FOR THE HIPS YOUR DESK HAS BEEN GLUING SHUT. LOOK LIKE YOU ARE PONDERING THE BLOODY CROSSWORD. RELAXED. SMUG EVEN.
exercises.speakRest: FIFTEEN. SWITCH SIDES. EYES ON YOU.
exercises.speakDone: HIP OPENERS DONE. THAT IS THE LOT.
